title: Elux Legend Grape Gummy Bear Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Elux Legend Grape Gummy Bear Nic Salt delivers the juicy taste of dark Grape with a sweet, confectionery-inspired twist. The Grape base is rich and vibrant, layered with sugary notes that echo the nostalgic flavour of fruity gummy sweets for a fun, flavour-packed vape. Created with double-concentrated flavouring, this e-liquid offers the kind of punchy, unmistakable taste that defines the Elux Legend range. With a 50VG/50PG ratio and smooth nicotine salt base, Grape Gummy Bear is tailored for MTL (mouth-to-lung) pod kits and starter devices. It provides clear, satisfying flavour with discreet vapour and a tactile yet comfortable throat hit. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths.
